inlines.v: DEFER, verb transitive [Latin To bear.] 1. To delay; to put off; to postpone to a future time; as, to defer the execution of a design. When thou vowest a vow, defer not to pay it. Ecclesiastes 5:4. Hope deferred maketh the heart sick. Proverbs 13:1. 2. To refer; to leave to anothers judgment and determination. [In this sense, refer is now used.]
